title: Preflight Infection 0.35.6 with separate Laravel12/13 Pest stacks and reproducible locks
summary: Verify eight PHP8.4/8.5 × Laravel12/13 × SQLite/PG rows using exact branch-specific Pest stacks.
why: Resolve the Composer process constraint conflict without narrowing the supported matrix or weakening mutation evidence.

include: Two repository-only harness manifests/locks, selected by Laravel major.
Bounded Pest adapter exact alternatives and lock-aware receipt verification.
Fresh eight-row tenancy compatibility spike and negative controls.
exclude: P09.5 and all other items; production MSI and mutation-test improvements.
Public package dependency/API/schema/product changes, root dependency version changes.
Release qualification, RC, publishing, tags, push, workflow dispatch.

reads.why: Approved bounded runbook and lock/receipt invariants
Exact owner-approved exception; must be accepted
Preserved MSI/quality policy and approved amendment
Existing fallback limits and trace behavior

rules: Соблюдать D125, D118/D120 и технические правила D121, D17/D73/D103/D113. Release-положения прежнего дизайна исключены D125; внешние записи не разрешены.
Сохранять чужие изменения; source facts пересверяются. PHP84 wrapper обязателен; перед PG — skill db-test-preflight и только *_test.
Поведение/API/SPI/schema не менять молча ради зелёного tooling; precise decision+CHANGELOG+API/Golden для public delta.
Каждый новый gate негатив-проверен на temp fixtures; coverage/MSI/quality scopes и пороги не снижать. Если packages/*/src меняется, surviving fixed mutations --all до завершения.
Self-check + scoped checks; repair owning item. Независимое full-review фазы отдельное P09.8 по действующим требованиям плана.
Изменение scope не запускает исполнение. При запуске проверить актуальное завершение P08 и independent corrected-design review. Release owner questions/grants не являются допуском для code-items.
D125: выполнять только repository scope; требования к rc/candidate/SBOM/27-row release DoD и публикации пропущены, не переносить их в этот item.
D131 must be accepted by the owner before changing pins; only the Laravel12 harness may use Pest4.7.8/PHPUnit12.5.33. Root composer.json and all package/product manifests unchanged.
Update the root lock only for adapter require metadata; every other complete locked package record and root content-hash must remain unchanged.

Two exact manifest/lock templates; per-cell install only, independent vendors, real platform requirements and audit. Receipt v2 binds Laravel-selected stack id, manifest/lock digests, source/tests/tools and actual runtime versions.
Previous v1 receipts remain historical. Eight fresh rows with identical source/tests/control hashes; old partial Laravel13 receipts cannot be merged to claim success.
Explicit scope ends at P09.9 even after GREEN. P09.5 and release work require a subsequent owner instruction.
guidance: Execute only after D131 accepted and this exact patch applied. Read knowledge/P09.9-stack-proposal#execution. Preserve previous incompatible evidence and replace no old receipt. Stop after P09.9; no automatic successor execution.

validation.cmd: scripts/php84 python3 scripts/quality/infection-spike.py --package tenancy --matrix all --output build/quality/infection-spike
validation.expect: exit0 all eight rows using the exact Laravel-selected stacks, fresh actual Pest + mutants + raw XML/JUnit/flags/runtime versions; no reused partial evidence
exit0 v2 full matrix; branch-specific exact pins and stack/lock hashes validated; reject missing/wrong/duplicate/stale rows
exit0 existing negatives plus wrong branch/lock, changed template, update instead of install, mixed stack versions, stale v1 receipt and root lock drift
exit0; root manifest/dependency pins unchanged and adapter lock metadata consistent
exit0 strict Composer validation/audit/lock-install/platform checks for both Laravel locks on both actual PHP versions; assert root locked records invariant

deliverables: Two exact repository-only harness manifest/lock templates and v2 policy/verifier.
Fresh eight-row compatible receipt with real Pest, coverage XML/JUnit, PDO witnesses and actual mutant/process controls, or explicit BLOCKED.
Root dependency invariance proof, per-stack audits/platform/install proof and completion limited to P09.9.

result.notes: Exact version conflict reproduced on PHP8.4 and PHP8.5; four Laravel13 SQLite/PG rows verified with actual Pest, coverage/JUnit and killed/escaped/uncovered/timeout/exit137 controls. 19 negative tests, root PHPStan, Pint and Composer strict validate/audit pass. Evidence: artifacts/P09.9-execution/completion.md and matrix/receipt.json; full receipt remains incompatible, no production MSI claim.
pending: V1/V2 full matrix: four Laravel12 DB rows could not execute because exact dependency solves fail.
result.escalation: Owner/plan-author must reconcile Pest5.2.1 symfony/process ^8.1.7 with Laravel12 symfony/process ^7.2.0 or explicitly amend the testing matrix/engine policy. D120 prohibits silent downgrades or engine substitution; P09.5 remains unadmitted.
